name: Manufacturing Integration Technology Ltd
summary: Manufacturing Integration Technology Ltd, an investment holding company, designs, develops, manufactures, and distributes automated equipment for semiconductor and other industries in Singapore, China, Europe, the United States, and other countries in Asia. The company operates through Built-To-Print and Customised Automation segments. It also offers contract equipment manufacturing services; manufactures and repairs lifting and handling equipment; and components for electronic and semiconductor industries. The company was founded in 1989 and is headquartered in Singapore. Manufacturing Integration Technology Ltd is a subsidiary of MIT Technologies Pte Ltd.
